'''Sianna Sekko''' was a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] from [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] and a [[Krath Death Witch]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Born into a wealthy family of [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] on [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]], Sianna Sekko was orphaned at a young age and inherited her family's estate. The estate's executor, Sekko's uncle, raised the girl as part of an underground cult that worshiped the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] legacy. Training Sekko in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the Krath taught her the ways of [[Mind trick/Legends|illusions]] and violence. Dispatched on missions to retrieve relics of ancient evils, Sekko received orders from a handler known only as "[[Tailor (Krath)|Tailor]]." Tailor taught her that the ruined [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] killed her parents before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] wiped them out at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], fostering a hatred of the Jedi in Sekko's heart. In fact, Tailor was the true mastermind of the Sekkos' demise, as part of his goal of recruiting their young daughter. Programming a cadre of [[Krath war droid/Legends|Krath war droids]] to fight and target [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Sekko was obsessed with eradicating the Order's remnants from the galaxy. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Sekko often roamed the [[Royal District/Legends|Royal District]] of [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]] in search of the fabled [[Iron Citadel/Legends|Iron Citadel's]] foundations.<ref name="NoP" />

==Powers and abilities==
A skilled witch, Sianna Sekko wielded a [[Krath blood blade|Blood Blade]] in combat, using the variation of the [[Form IV/Legends|Ataru]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|technique]] in combat. Additionally, Sekko carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] for her defense.<ref name="NoP" />
